contracts.metric_contract: minutes of downtime or good units per fixed interval
transfer_rules: Use an existing proof-to-pilot intake and replay runner; this is not a new platform.
Re-freeze the protocol for this data domain; energy thresholds and error distributions do not transfer.
Keep late-arriving or revised data separate from what was available at issue time.
Run in read-only replay; human decision owner retains operational authority.
